subject: Post-demo: IR evidence intake & compliance ask — Harrison Health
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@harrisonhealth.com>, Mike Zhang <mike.zhang@harrisonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: IR evidence intake & compliance ask — Harrison Health

Hi Erin / Mike — great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single lane for compliance/IR artifacts that your security team needs for procurement.

Recap from Redwood side:
- Demo highlights: dedicated private deploy looks like the right fit for your PHI workflows; we covered VPC peering, KMS key ownership, and selective logging.
- Key question areas you flagged: SOC 2 status & scope, HIPAA posture for ingestion/storage, IR/breach notification timelines, and BCP/DR evidence for audit.

As discussed, can you confirm the following so we can scope a vendor intake?
1) Current SOC 2 status (Type II in progress / in-scope controls).
2) Are you processing PHI today for the use-case here? (You mentioned yes for a subset of workflows.)
3) Target timeline for procurement to close (we suggested 6–8 weeks if artifacts are available).

To make this easy, attached two small stubs we typically share with security teams: IR_Timeline_Template.xlsx and BCP_DR_Runbook.pdf — these are templates to speed review (redacted examples). If you prefer, Marissa can run the questionnaire directly and we can intake documents into our secure review portal.

Suggested next actions:
- Erin: if you can drop a short SOC-2 status note and confirm PHI scope by EOD Wed (6/17), we’ll start mapping required artifacts.
- We’ll start the vendor questionnaire and send the secure upload link; aim to have initial draft evidence uploaded by 6/24.
- Propose a 30-min follow-up with your security lead on Tue 6/23 to walk the artifacts and IR timeline.

Attachments: IR_Timeline_Template.xlsx (stub), BCP_DR_Runbook.pdf (stub)

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0198
From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@harrisonhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mike Zhang <mike.zhang@harrisonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 12:03:24 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: IR evidence intake & compliance ask — Harrison Health

Sergio — thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers below and a couple of attachments we have on-hand.

- SOC 2: We completed a readiness assessment and are currently in a Type II engagement with an auditor; expected report delivery Q3 (target Aug). I attached a short SOC2_Status_Summary.pdf that describes scope and timeline.
- PHI: yes — certain patient-identifiable fields are in scope for the triage flow. We have a signed BA with a few vendors; will need to confirm any new vendor language.
- IR/breach notification: our policy requires internal detection -> notify legal & customers within 48 hours of confirmation; we can provide our incident classification matrix but will need to align on definitions for third-party detection.

We’re happy to do the 6/23 follow-up with our Security Ops lead Laura Nguyen. Can you send the vendor questionnaire link and a suggested agenda for the 30-min alignment?

Attachments: SOC2_Status_Summary.pdf (provided), Incident_Classification_Matrix.pdf (internal)

Best,
Erin
Erin Cole
Director, Security & Compliance | Harrison Health
erin.cole@harrisonhealth.com | +1 617-555-2233
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@harrisonhealth.com>, Mike Zhang <mike.zhang@harrisonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: IR evidence intake & compliance ask — Harrison Health

Thanks Erin — helpful.

I attached the IR_Timeline_Template.xlsx filled with our suggested timeline (we keep it conservative):
- Day 0: detection and initial triage (your SOC/alerts)
- Day 0–2: confirmation + internal notifications (legal, security ops)
- Day 2–5: containment and evidence capture (logs, KV cache review, model input tracing where applicable)
- Day 5–14: forensic analysis + external notifications if confirmed

We also included BCP_DR_Runbook.pdf for your Ops team as a format example (redacted). For the vendor questionnaire we’ll start the intake here: 
https://vendor-questionnaire.redwood.com/start?acct=DH-7842

Proposed short agenda for 6/23 call with Laura Nguyen:
- 5m intros and scope confirmation
- 10m SOC 2/HIPAA scoping and evidence list
- 10m IR timeline & notification obligations alignment
- 5m next steps and upload logistics

Ben — looping you in to coordinate secure upload and to kick off the HubSpot deal record for compliance artifacts.

Attachments: IR_Timeline_Template.xlsx (stub), BCP_DR_Runbook.pdf (stub)

— Sergio
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo: IR evidence intake & compliance ask — Harrison Health

Great thread — thanks Sergio. Quick internal checklist before the 6/23 call: 
- Ben, please create the secure evidence folder and send Erin the upload token. Use the Drive link template and enforce read-only.
- I’ll prepare a concise artifact ask list (SOC 2 bridge letters, control mappings, encryption/KMS configs, BA details) — target delivery 6/24.
- Sergio, ask procurement to flag any required BA redlines; if Harrison needs terms edits we’ll route to Legal with a standard timeline (7–10 business days).

I’ll also log the items on HubSpot for DH-7842 and add the call to the booking.
